Orthogonality of each speed residual gives exact Var(R(p_j))-Var(m_i)=E[mdot_i²] and Var(m_i)-Var(p_i)=β^-2E[pdot_i²]. Vanishing of either speed on invariant support propagates constancy through the cyclic graph via strict monotonicity of R(s), so every non-equilibrium μ has all three strict variance cascades and Var(p_i)>0. The global Lipschitz estimate Var(R(P))≤L²Var(P) gives the cyclic product 1<L^6, hence L>1 is necessary. Maximizing |R'(s)| for R=α/(1+s^h)+α₀ at s^h=(h-1)/(h+1) gives L=α(h+1)²/(4h)((h-1)/(h+1))^((h-1)/h); h=2 specializes 9α/(8√3). Claims are sufficient obstruction, not sharp Hopf threshold.
